descriptionChirho: Active plundering or despoiling in the Qal stem, including participial agent nouns ('plunderers', 'one who plunders') and finite verb forms ('plundered', 'shall plunder'), all denoting the act of seizing spoil by force.
Passive participial form indicating the state of having been plundered or despoiled, describing the victim or object of plundering rather than the agent.
Intensive Piel stem form denoting thorough, complete, or emphatic plundering, conveying a more forceful or exhaustive act of despoiling than the basic Qal.
